{"sourceType":"ESA Tender Action","sourceSystem":"ESA esa-star Publication","sourcePage":"https://esastar-publication-ext.sso.esa.int/ESATenderActions/filter/open","id":187954,"idEra":25170,"activityNumber":"1000046640","contractNumber":"","tanumber":"1-13553","title":"ADHA SOFTWARE ARCHITECTURE - EXPRO+","description":"Objective: To develop a complete Software product portfolio of building blocks facilitating the integration of ADHA platforms in Mid-size LEO satellite platforms.Description: The Advanced Data Handling Architecture (ADHA) has been developed as a set of hardware components with standardized communication interfaces. Previous work has focused on the hardware aspects, but the current situation highlights the need for a robust software stack to support ADHA in space missions, in particular mid-sized LEO satellites. The main concern is to ensure that enough software components are ready for use in flight and developed using modern, modular techniques to enhance compatibility and performance. This activity aims to provide a modular software stack that can be utilized across different ADHA-based computers, including On-Board Computers (OBCs) and Instrument Control Units (ICUs) from various vendors. By leveraging different European processors, FPGA, and other COTS processors commonly used in commercial satellites, the software stack is aimed at offering flexibility and interoperability. The added value includes improved mission reliability, reduced development time, and cost savings through standardized software components. The configuration and deployment of the software will be integrated into a model-based software development and code generation tools such as TASTE using Space Creator, facilitating streamlined development and deployment processes.
